description.value: A certified organic vegetable farm in South Delta growing more than forty varieties of produce. They operate a farm stand for most of the year and also sell bedding plants and organic seedlings. A good stop for touring cyclists looking for fresh, locally grown food near the Tsawwassen ferry terminal area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Snow Farms is an active certified organic vegetable farm in South Delta with a farm stand open 10 months of the year and an online shop with pickup. The website provides the address (3531 64 Street, Delta, BC V4K 3N2) and phone (778 434 5031) that are absent from the OSM record. They sell over 40 varieties of organic vegetables, which qualifies as basic groceries for a touring cyclist. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags regarding bike parking, water refills, washrooms, or any other amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; website provides both (3531 64 Street, Delta, BC V4K 3N2 and 778 434 5031). OSM tags should be updated.
Farm stand produce is seasonal — may have limited stock in winter months though the stand reportedly operates 10 months of the year.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active organic farm stand selling fresh produce near cycling routes in the Tsawwassen/South Delta area. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists despite limited confirmed amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: Primarily a wholesale vegetable operation with a retail farm stand. Online ordering available with pickup only on limited days.

wow_evidence: certified organic vegetable farm... over 40 varieties... farm stand open 10 months of the year
